headline: Yulan Bond Debuts in Dubai Amid Beijing's Yuan Asset Push
summary: The Yulan renminbi bond structure made its Dubai debut with an offshore bond issued by the Bank of China, drawing strong investor interest and oversubscribing its order book more than five times.
why: Expanding offshore yuan-denominated debt issuance supports Beijing's broader campaign for the internationalization of its currency.

impacts.name: Chinese Yuan
impacts.why: Strong demand for offshore yuan-denominated bonds deepens international liquidity pools for the currency.
